description: Private-sector currency flow (revenue / cost / investment / m&a consideration) emitted by legal-entity DIDs. ADR-0028. PII tier 1 — aggregate only, no individual counterparty. ADR-0018 k-anonymity: cohort_size >= 5 when customer cohort is attached.

sourceDid.description: Legal-entity facade DID (did:web / did:plc). The canonical actor vector key is sourceRootDid (ADR-0074).

sourceRootDid.description: ADR-0074 canonical ERC725 root for sourceDid (did:erc725:etzhayyim:260425:<contract>). Optional during migration; required once etzhayyimRootIdentity is registered.

counterpartyDid.description: Legal-entity facade DID of counterparty. Individual DIDs forbidden (ADR-0018).

counterpartyRootDid.description: ADR-0074 canonical ERC725 root for counterpartyDid. Optional during migration.

industryCode.description: ISIC rev4 code (e.g. I5510 for hotels)

cohortId.description: ADR-0027 cohort actor DID when revenue is attributed to a customer cohort.

cohortSize.description: k-anonymity bucket size. Required when cohortId is set. ADR-0018.

sourceUrl.description: Authoritative source URL (IR report / gov filing / earnings release)
